settings.text: Frequently Asked Questions

settings.repere: Texte · Will my phone case fit on my cell phon…
settings.text: Will my phone case fit on my cell phone after attaching the Lifetune One?

settings.repere: Texte · The device can be placed either on the…
settings.text: The device can be placed either on the phone case or the actual device itself. If you place your Lifetune One on the device itself, a phone case will not fit over the phone and device as the One is slightly raised like a bubble. You can place the One on phone case without any trouble, but due to having an adhesive it won't be able to transfer from one case to another for multiple uses.

settings.repere: Texte · What is the effective range of the Lif…
settings.text: What is the effective range of the Lifetune One?

settings.repere: Texte · The effective coverage diameter is 19 …
settings.text: The effective coverage diameter is 19 feet (5.5 meters)

settings.repere: Texte · Can the Aires Lifetune One be reapplie…
settings.text: Can the Aires Lifetune One be reapplied on another device?

settings.repere: Texte · Yes, the Aires Lifetune One can be rea…
settings.text: Yes, the Aires Lifetune One can be reapplied to either the same device or a new one. Its design includes two extra adhesive stickers to make reapplication simple and secure, even if the original adhesive wears down.

settings.repere: Texte · Reapplying to the Same Device:
settings.text: Reapplying to the Same Device:

settings.repere: Texte · Clean the device’s surface to remove a…
settings.text: Clean the device’s surface to remove any residue or dust.

settings.repere: Texte · Remove the old adhesive from the Lifet…
settings.text: Remove the old adhesive from the Lifetune One.

settings.repere: Texte · Attach a new adhesive sticker to the b…
settings.text: Attach a new adhesive sticker to the back of the Lifetune One.

settings.repere: Texte · Press the Lifetune One firmly onto the…
settings.text: Press the Lifetune One firmly onto the device.

settings.repere: Texte · Moving to a New Device
settings.text: Moving to a New Device

settings.repere: Texte · Gently remove the Lifetune One from th…
settings.text: Gently remove the Lifetune One from the original device.

settings.repere: Texte · Clean the surface of the new device.
settings.text: Clean the surface of the new device.

settings.repere: Texte · Attach a fresh adhesive sticker to the…
settings.text: Attach a fresh adhesive sticker to the back of the Lifetune One.

settings.repere: Texte · Secure it onto the new device by press…
settings.text: Secure it onto the new device by pressing firmly.

settings.repere: Texte · Do I need more than one Lifetune One o…
settings.text: Do I need more than one Lifetune One on each electronic device?

settings.repere: Texte · One unit of the Lifetune One is enough…
settings.text: One unit of the Lifetune One is enough for one small device, such as a cell phone, tablet, Wi-Fi router, etc. For area coverage, we recommend one of our larger devices such as the Lifetune Zone or Lifetune Zone Max.

settings.repere: Texte · How Do I adhere the Lifetune One to my…
settings.text: How Do I adhere the Lifetune One to my device?

settings.repere: Texte · Clean the surface of the electronic de…
settings.text: Clean the surface of the electronic device you wish to attach the One to. Peel the One from the white square backing and press firmly for approximately 30 seconds. Can be attached directly to an electronic device or onto a protective case. The One has a protective polymer coating and is water-resistant.

settings.repere: Texte · How do I know if my Aires product is d…
settings.text: How do I know if my Aires product is damaged?

settings.repere: Texte · Some signs of damage to look for are a…
settings.text: Some signs of damage to look for are any cracks, chips or other wear and tear in or around the Aires silicon resonator chip. In addition, some signs of water damage include droplets/bubbling either in or around the Aires silicon resonator chip or discolouration of this area.
